title: Pro-etale vector integration and its adjoint arrows
statement:
In the finite coordinates for $\ell,E,n,A$, let $S$ be Noetherian with $\ell$ invertible, $\pi:V\to S$ a vector bundle of rank $d\geq0$, and $r\geq0$ with $\ell^{r+1}A=0$. Its ordered Tate coefficient $W=\pi_e^*L_S(d)[2d]$ is bounded below. Define the pro-etale compact-support source as $R\pi_!^p C_VW$ using the same canonical compactification as ordinary integration. Define its site comparison with $C_SR\pi_!^e W$ by the canonical proper counit mate and extension-by-zero comparison. The ordered local integrations agree on overlaps and there is a unique map $t_\pi^p:R\pi_!^p C_VW\to C_SA_S$ whose restriction in every frame is that local integration, with the canonical pullback and source comparisons inserted. Define $t_\pi^p$ by this unique property.

proof.text: For vectorCoefficient_plus, use rightTower_plus for boundedness below of the right tower at the constant object, with the canonical normalized ordinary Tate transport. The canonical affineLinearCoefficientDescent identifies that object with pullback of the ordered base coefficient. Construct the zero section of the affine tower recursively and verify that its composite with the tower projection is the identity. Exact inverse image preserves a lower bound; pull back along this section and use leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso to deduce boundedness of the base coefficient. Pulling it to the vector bundle gives boundedness of vectorIntegrationCoefficient. This includes rank zero and the empty base.

For existsUniqueVectorIntegration, use orderedIntegration_comparison on every frame. Unfolding chartPrefix identifies localIntegration with comparison of the canonical ordinary local trace. Naturality of pullback comparison and its constant-unit equation identify VectorNormalization of vectorSite.hom followed by comparison(g) with ordinary VectorIntegrationNormalization(g). Tate-transport and projective-datum uniqueness extend the fixed normalized datum to the universally quantified ordinary normalization. The ordinary vectorBundleIntegration supplies existence. Any pro-etale map, after vectorSite.inv, has a unique ordinary preimage because the target constant complex is bounded below and comparison is bijective on this Hom set. Ordinary gluing uniqueness then identifies the preimage with vectorBundleIntegration. For ordinary uniqueness, express an arbitrary map using the fixed degree-zero gluing isomorphism and full faithfulness of the single functor, and apply uniqueness of the normalized gluing pair. All source comparisons and the named integration definition remain unchanged.
